tasks: place the square building blocks in the center with left hand and put the cylindrical building blocks on top with right hand.

generation_prompt: The robot's left hand closes its thumb and curled fingers around the blue K cube, lifts it, and sets it on top of the yellow cube, then opens and withdraws. Afterward the right hand reaches in, grips the green Z cube between its fingers and thumb, lifts it, carries it over, and sets it on top of the blue cube, then opens and pulls back while the left hand stays idle, leaving a three-cube tower. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
data_quality_gate.exception_reason: Dataset-wide exception (2026-10-15), granted after visual review of the first episodes: edges of the hands and blocks were judged acceptable; the low score is driven mostly by the large untextured table.
